identity.real_world_identity_notes: Customer GT3 racing car built on the R35 GT-R with the VR38DETT twin-turbo V6. The NISMO customer-racing specification lists a six-speed sequential transmission with semi-automatic paddle shift as standard equipment.

wheel_rim.notes: NISMO's exact 2018 specification says the wheel was redesigned but does not establish its normalized rim geometry.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, six paddle-selected gears, and automatic cut and blip.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip. This matches every other curated paddle-shift GT3 car.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.nissan-gt-r-nismo-gt3.20260813t160420958z-7924b51a by Jason Kinslow.

overrides.condition: AMS2 1.6.9.91 accepted clutch-free move-off with automatic clutch and shifting disabled.

confidence.basis: Direct cockpit inspection during the guided drive.

claims.basis: NISMO's exact 2018 specification establishes a metal four-plate clutch but gives no move-off procedure. Clutch construction alone cannot establish required driver input.
NISMO says the 2018 wheel was redesigned for improved operability but supplies no round, D-shaped, or GT/Formula geometry. Earlier wheel descriptions are not inherited.
The registered source establishes the real-world identity and transmission, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The manufacturer customer-racing specification lists a six-speed sequential transmission with semi-automatic paddle shift; the live drive confirmed six paddle gears and clutch-free move-off.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.
Telemetry name `Nissan GT R Nismo GT3 2018`, internal id `nissan_gt_r_gt3_2018`, and class `GT3` map to the NISMO 2018 specification and explicitly exclude ACC's 2015 variant.

deviations.basis: Whether the car needs a throttle lift on upshifts is not established. A guided drive settles it, by holding the throttle through an upshift and seeing whether the gear engages.
The exact 2018 specification identifies a clutch but no move-off procedure, so authentic driver clutch use remains open rather than inheriting either simulator's answer.
